tells.1: Polished, uniform consulting-template structure (Recommendation / Why now / Rationale / Risks and mitigations), with every bullet expanded to the same smooth, balanced length.
tells.3: Bolded lead-in phrases on every rationale, reinvestment and risk bullet, plus the stock 'I'm happy to walk through...' closer.
tells.4: Markdown ## headers in an internal memo, and every mitigation rewritten into a parallel 'We will...' sentence.

reason: Version 2 reads most like a real person's draft: the phrasing is loose and repetitive, and the mitigations are vague. It is weaker on clarity and credibility, though. Version 1 keeps the polished structure and specific detail without the heavy bolding or markdown headers, so it is the strongest memo to actually send.
